<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="heroFade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.08"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.78"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="heroGlow" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B1060F" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E50815" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Hero image -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="430" fill="#111111"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="430" fill="url(#heroFade)"/>
  
  <!-- Abstract hero illustration using geometric shapes -->
  <g opacity="0.95">
    <rect x="0" y="120" width="390" height="210" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
    <rect x="16" y="115" width="358" height="220" rx="18" fill="#131313"/>
    <circle cx="83" cy="177" r="24" fill="#2A2A2A"/>
    <circle cx="119" cy="161" r="18" fill="#1F1F1F"/>
    <circle cx="286" cy="167" r="28" fill="#242424"/>
    <rect x="70" y="194" width="192" height="74" rx="22" fill="#1A1A1A"/>
    <rect x="87" y="208" width="114" height="18" rx="9" fill="#E50815" opacity="0.9"/>
    <rect x="208" y="208" width="31" height="18" rx="9" fill="#EE1520" opacity="0.7"/>
    <circle cx="93" cy="229" r="10" fill="#EE1520"/>
    <circle cx="119" cy="229" r="10" fill="#737373"/>
    <circle cx="145" cy="229" r="10" fill="#737373"/>
    <circle cx="171" cy="229" r="10" fill="#737373"/>
    <rect x="247" y="194" width="54" height="74" rx="14" fill="#1F1F1F"/>
    <rect x="257" y="206" width="34" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <rect x="257" y="220" width="22" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <rect x="257" y="234" width="28" height="8" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF33"/>
    <polygon points="322,256 343,225 366,256" fill="#202020"/>
    <circle cx="338" cy="230" r="6" fill="#FFFFFF82"/>
    <rect x="24" y="270" width="342" height="18" rx="9" fill="#00000042"/>
    <rect x="24" y="270" width="132" height="18" rx="9" fill="#EE1520"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <text x="20" y="29" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500">9:41</text>
    <rect x="310" y="18" width="5" height="8" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="318" y="15" width="5" height="11" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="326" y="12" width="5" height="14" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="334" y="9" width="5" height="17" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="18" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="357" y1="18" x2="371" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="364" y1="12" x2="364" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="373" y="12" width="18" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="392" y="16" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="381" cy="18" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Logo -->
  <g transform="translate(18,52)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="88" height="24" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="0" y="19" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#E50815" letter-spacing="-1">N</text>
    <text x="16" y="19" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#E50815" letter-spacing="-1">E</text>
    <text x="29" y="19" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#E50815" letter-spacing="-1">T</text>
    <text x="42" y="19" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#E50815" letter-spacing="-1">F</text>
    <text x="55" y="19" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#E50815" letter-spacing="-1">L</text>
    <text x="68" y="19" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#E50815" letter-spacing="-1">I</text>
    <text x="76" y="19" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#E50815" letter-spacing="-1">X</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Slogan -->
  <text x="20" y="526" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="31" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">No pesky contracts</text>
  <text x="20" y="554" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.88">Join today, cancel anytime. Stream on any device,</text>
  <text x="20" y="575" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.88">anywhere, without commitments.</text>

  <!-- Paging dots -->
  <g transform="translate(168,607)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="14" cy="0" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="0" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="0" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF5C"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Help / Privacy links -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="673" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Help</text>
    <text x="64" y="673" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Privacy</text>
    <line x1="55" y1="661" x2="55" y2="676" stroke="#FFFFFF33" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Subtle promo copy -->
  <text x="20" y="724" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.55">Unlimited entertainment from $6.99/month after trial.</text>
  <text x="20" y="744" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.55">No hidden fees. No contracts. Cancel anytime.</text>

  <!-- SIGN IN button -->
  <g transform="translate(17,763)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="356" height="44" rx="2" fill="#E50815"/>
    <text x="178" y="27" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="88" fill="#000000"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="756" x2="390" y2="756" stroke="#1A1A1A" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g transform="translate(22,770)" fill="#FFFFFF82">
    <rect x="10" y="2" width="18" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="10" y1="9" x2="28" y2="9" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="19" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Home</text>
  </g>

  <g transform="translate(103,770)" fill="#FFFFFF82">
    <circle cx="19" cy="9" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="15" x2="30" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="19" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Search</text>
  </g>

  <g transform="translate(184,770)" fill="#FFFFFF82">
    <rect x="8" y="1" width="22" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polygon points="14,5 14,13 21,9" fill="#FFFFFF82"/>
    <text x="19" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">Downloads</text>
  </g>

  <g transform="translate(265,770)" fill="#FFFFFF82">
    <circle cx="19" cy="9" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="19" cy="9" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF82"/>
    <line x1="19" y1="1" x2="19" y2="0" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="25" y1="3" x2="26" y2="2" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <line x1="27" y1="9" x2="28" y2="9" stroke="#FFFFFF82" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="19" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Netflix Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF82">More</text>
  </g>
</svg>
